dedupe_keys.name: d 2epc bim based digital twin data model example and real time building measurements

description: D^2EPC BIM-based Digital Twin data model example and real-time building measurements is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Nikolaos Katsaros, Panagiota Chatzipanagiotidou (Centre for Research and Technology Hellas). An example building digital twin data model, developed within the H2020 project D^2EPC, corresponding to the first out of six Case Studies (CERTH nZEB Smart House DIH). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
